card.name: Numbers just before a unit of measure
card.fires_on: Numbers or number words (one, eight, 0 in 50 or 60) and small words right before them, where a quantity with a unit such as mg, mL, times or grams comes next. Seen in dosing text and in hummingbird weight and food facts.
